diff --git a/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py b/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py
index 00e30cf23..39507cefb 100644
--- a/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py
+++ b/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/base/llms/types.py
@@ -55,6 +55,7 @@ class ImageBlock(BaseModel):
     url: AnyUrl | str | None = None
     image_mimetype: str | None = None
     detail: str | None = None
+    encoding: Literal["base64", "raw"] = "base64"
 
     @field_validator("url", mode="after")
     @classmethod
@@ -79,7 +80,8 @@ class ImageBlock(BaseModel):
             guess = filetype.guess(self.image)
             self.image_mimetype = guess.mime if guess else None
 
-        self.image = base64.b64encode(self.image)
+        if self.encoding == "base64":
+            self.image = base64.b64encode(self.image)
 
         return self
 
@@ -90,6 +92,10 @@ class ImageBlock(BaseModel):
             as_base64 (bool): whether the resolved image should be returned as base64-encoded bytes
         """
         if self.image is not None:
+            if self.encoding == "raw":
+                if as_base64:
+                    return BytesIO(base64.b64encode(self.image))
+                return BytesIO(self.image)
             if as_base64:
                 return BytesIO(self.image)
             return BytesIO(base64.b64decode(self.image))
@@ -108,6 +114,24 @@ class ImageBlock(BaseModel):
         else:
             raise ValueError("No image found in the chat message!")
 
+    def get_image_mimetype(self) -> str | None:
+        """Return the image mimetype, guessing and caching it if not already set.
+
+        The mimetype is computed lazily from the image data the first time this
+        method is called, then stored in `image_mimetype` for future accesses.
+        """
+        if self.image_mimetype:
+            return self.image_mimetype
+
+        try:
+            img_bytes = self.resolve_image(as_base64=False).getvalue()
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+
+        guess = filetype.guess(img_bytes)
+        self.image_mimetype = guess.mime if guess else None
+        return self.image_mimetype
+
 
 ContentBlock = Annotated[
     Union[TextBlock, ImageBlock], Field(discriminator="block_type")
